name: com.apix402data/x402-data-api
title: x402 Data API (Crypto, DeFi, SEC EDGAR, Search, Embeddings, Whisper, OCR)
description: 33 pay-per-call AI, PDF OCR, JSON extract, DeFi, and SEC tools via x402 & Stripe MPP.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: [$0.002] Search live web and news articles by query (or up to 5 batched queries) via Google News RSS and web indexes. Returns structured titles, URLs, snippets, and source metadata as JSON. Do not use for single-URL extraction (use web_fetch_markdown) or crypto ticker feeds (use news_crypto_feed). `q` and `query` are aliases, `queries` overrides them for up to 5 batched lookups, and omitting all returns top headlines. Live web/RSS data, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

q.description: Search query — supports AI, crypto, finance, tech, biotech, energy topics

category.description: Filter by category: web or news

limit.description: Max results to return per query (default 50, max 500)

queries.description: Batch: array of up to 5 queries; priced unit price x count

fields.description: Return only these result keys, e.g. ["title","url","enrichment.sentiment"]

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

tools.name: web_fetch_markdown
tools.description: [$0.002] Fetch any public HTTPS webpage with SSRF protection, strip navigation/ad boilerplate, and return clean LLM-ready Markdown, word count, and extracted entities as JSON. Do not use for searching across sites (use web_search) or auditing x402 endpoints (use x402_endpoint_audit). Only `summarize=true` invokes the local LLM, and expiring `timeout_ms` returns `degraded=true` with extracted Markdown but no summary. Live SSRF-guarded HTTPS fetch, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

url.description: Any public URL to fetch, clean, and extract content from

summarize.description: Add LLM-powered summary with entity extraction and sentiment scoring

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

tools.name: news_crypto_feed
tools.description: [$0.002] Get real-time cryptocurrency and DeFi news headlines enriched with per-article sentiment scores and mentioned token tickers in structured JSON. Do not use for general web search (use web_search) or SEC filings (use sec_company_lookup). `ticker` and `asset` are aliases, and `sort='quality'` (default) ranks by freshness+tier while `'newest'` sorts strictly chronologically. Live feeds, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

asset.description: Alias of ticker (e.g. USDC, BTC, ETH)

sort.description: quality (freshness + outlet + coverage, default) or newest

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

tools.name: sec_company_lookup
tools.description: [$0.002] Look up public company financials, CIK, recent SEC EDGAR filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K), and recent news sentiment by stock ticker (supports up to 5 batched tickers). Do not use for crypto tokens (use token_market_snapshot) or open web search (use web_search). `tickers` overrides `ticker` to batch up to 5 symbols, while `include_news=false` skips headline sentiment to reduce latency. Live SEC EDGAR data, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

ticker.description: Any SEC-registered stock ticker (e.g., AAPL, COST, WMT, NVDA). Unknown tickers return 404 and are not charged.

tools.name: x402_endpoint_audit
tools.description: [$0.002] Pre-flight x402 endpoint security firewall. Probes any x402 URL before payment to detect wallet-drain price spikes, SIWx origin spoofing, fake USDC contracts, and prompt injections. Do not use for EVM calldata/Permit2 vetting (use workflow_tx_guardian) or token bytecode scans (use token_contract_audit). `method` sets the HTTP probe verb (`GET` vs `POST`) used to trigger the 402 header, `deep_audit=true` runs prompt-injection checks, and `max_acceptable_usd` caps price validation. Live HTTP probe, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

deep_audit.description: Add one local-LLM prompt-injection audit of the 402 metadata

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

tools.name: token_market_snapshot
tools.description: [$0.003] Live token price, liquidity, FDV, market cap, 24h volume, price change, and buy/sell order flow from DEX pairs, plus deterministic anomaly flags and a local qwen3.5:4b momentum and risk read. Do not use for contract bytecode safety (use token_contract_audit) or DeFi yield pools (use defi_yield_pools). `chain` defaults to `'base'` (supports base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, solana), and expiring `timeout_ms` returns `degraded=true` omitting the LLM summary. Live DEX data, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

tools.name: workflow_tx_guardian
tools.description: [$0.04] Trigger When: vetting an EVM tx or off-chain Permit2/EIP-712 signature. Workflow Outcome: runs calldata/typed-data decode, bytecode & taint audit, eth_call simulation, and safe rewrite. Do not use for protocol TVL/circuit-breaker audits (use workflow_protocol_audit) or token-only bytecode scans (use token_contract_audit). Supply `to`+`data` for calldata simulation, `typed_data` for off-chain EIP-712/Permit2 vetting, or both; `from_addr` enables sender-accurate `eth_call`. Live RPC/bytecode/taint check, read-only non-custodial (no broadcast); requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

tools.name: workflow_defi_shield
tools.description: [$0.04] Trigger When: guarding a DeFi wallet against liquidation or stale approvals. Workflow Outcome: stress-tests Aave/Compound health factor (-10%/-20%) and builds unsigned repay & revoke txs. Do not use for pool yield discovery (use defi_yield_pools) or wallet PnL logs (use workflow_treasury_audit). The `-10%` and `-20%` collateral drops are fixed stress simulations, while `target_health_factor` sets the safety target used to size `unsigned_aave_repay_tx`. Live Aave/Compound RPCs, read-only non-custodial (no broadcast); requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

tools.name: workflow_cross_arb
tools.description: [$0.04] Trigger When: sizing cross-chain DEX arbitrage after all fees. Workflow Outcome: verifies dual-chain RPCs, deducts gas, bridge, and slippage costs, and outputs a tranche plan. tools.name: agent_session_open
tools.description: [$1.00] Deposit $1.00 USDC once to mint an HMAC-signed Bearer session token (x402s_...) for zero-402 high-frequency API calls with atomic balance debits. Do not use for single paid calls or read-only checks (call any tool directly with x402/MPP). Every call charges `$1.00` USDC and mints a fresh `x402s_...` Bearer session (does not top up prior sessions); `ttl_minutes` sets expiry and `payer_address` binds ownership. Persists prepaid meter in SQLite (non-custodial); requires x402/MPP at 30-60 req/min.
